title: ゴルシちゃん主催！人狼は誰だ！？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Bonjour! Comment allez-vous! It's time to begin the bloody feud that is the Werewolf game!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, sounds like a blast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship is hosting a social deduction game called Werewolf. Besides herself and Nakayama Festa, the participants include…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sirius Symboli, El Condor Pasa…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Manhattan Cafe, Satono Diamond, and inexplicably, I've also managed to get myself wrapped up in this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The rules are simple! We must uncover the werewolves hiding among us through rational discussion. No fist fights! Ya got that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The roles are divided as follows—two werewolves, one maniac, one fortune teller, one medium, and two villagers. I'm one of the villagers.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So, without further ado, let the game begin!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: There aren't many players, so I'll go ahead and reveal that I'm the fortune teller.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ha, you already trying to con everyone, Sirius? I'm the real fortune teller.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh heh. Look at you, coming at me like it's nothing. I'll make sure you regret this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey now, is one of you a werewolf? …Wait, actually, I'm getting strong maniac vibes here. Well, you both act like maniacs in real life anyway, so who can say!

text_block_list.name: Sirius & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: You're one to talk!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey, El's usually super boisterous. How come she's being so quiet?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …The werewolves tend to say very little. I believe we should vote to execute El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So begins the second day… Gracious! The heroine Golshi was tragically torn apart by a werewolf and is now watching over you from the heavens above.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: My divination is telling me that Manhattan Cafe is a werewolf.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, my divination says that Satono Diamond's a werewolf.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um… Given what I know, that makes Nakayama the fake fortune teller, and Cafe is a werewolf.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I believe… the opposite. Satono is a werewolf.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well, it seems this discussion has come to a stalemate. Although, that's the real thrill of this game. Hehe… I'm getting quite excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Given the state of things, it's likely that Sirius Symboli and Satono Diamond will vote to execute Manhattan Cafe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Nakayama Festa and Manhattan Cafe will vote to execute Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That leaves the deciding vote in my hands! Do I vote for Manhattan Cafe or Satono Diamond?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Please think back, Trainer. Who was it that first cast suspicion on El?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I remember now. And it look likes those suspicions were right on the money. Which means…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Time to announce the result! Victory goes to… the werewolf team!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sirius Symboli was the one who identified El Condor Pasa as a werewolf, so she's the real fortune teller?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, sorry for betraying your trust in me, Trainer. I was the maniac, and I ratted El out—I sacrificed my ally.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: By uncovering one of the werewolves, I made it look like I was the real fortune teller.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha! The maniac sacrificing a werewolf? I like it. You really threw the standard tactic out the window.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: That gave my claims as the fortune teller more credibility. And hey, we won in the end, so it's all good.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Siriuuusss! Thank you so muuuuch!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Though… you did execute me on the first day.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha! You were the perfect bait!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe, we won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While reeling at how thoroughly I was duped, I can't help but feel impressed at how clever everyone's strategies were. Their scheming certainly made for a fun time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Time to announce the result! Victory goes to… the villager team!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That didn't go as I'd hoped.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sirius Symboli was indeed the first one to cast suspicion on El Condor Pasa. However, I surmised that she was sacrificing her own ally with that ploy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she was the maniac or a werewolf herself, then deliberately revealing one of the werewolves would make her claims as the "fortune teller" far more persuasive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I concluded that was exactly the kind of crafty scheme Sirius Symboli would stake her chances on.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Thank you, Trainer. Your judgment was… pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nice job seeing through Sirius's tricks. That wasn't too shabby at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yay! A glorious victory for Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Not like I got a chance to actually do anything, though! You lousy bunch of… No, it was all you, Satono! Don't go devouring the medium on the first day, you cretin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Things looked a little dicey for a moment, but I managed to win it for us. Really immersing yourself in such an intense game certainly makes for a fun time.
